title: When the Interior Wakes
author: Quentin Montrose
blurb: Rosalind Marchetti, a restaurant critic who has forgotten how food tastes, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must forgive the stranger in the old photographs, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
